The dose described in this report is very high, potentially beyond Erowid's 'heavy' range, and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
I have been using neurotin for several years now (around 8) and have always been increasing the dose. I started at around 900mg by taking them out of the capsules and empting the powder onto a paper towel and then swallowing all of it (the taste of nuerotin is rotten quite possibly the worst tasting drug I have ever taken). I feel the buzz is a lot like alcohol without the nausea but many of my friends describe a totally diffrent buzz and it can take some of them up to 3 hours for the effects to sit in. Afterwards we always smoke a few grams of marijuana which drastically increases the buzz.
I have suffered no bad effects from them and I now take up to 20 800mg pills at one time and it takes me about 1 hour and 30 min to feel them with the max effect around 3 to 4 hours. It is a very different kind of feeling than most drugs I have taken before and it is hard to describe the effects. They also seem to vary from person to person so be careful on your dose. From what I have read 16,000mg is a really high dose (I wonder if you can OD from this drug) so do not start out anywhere near this dose.
My wife has been taken them as long as I have and she still only takes around 2400mg and acts more tore up than me.
